messages.content: Thank you for all the valuable data! If it is at all possible to share, what criteria is being used for which episodes get included in each day's index?
messages.rawMarkdown: Thank you for all the valuable data!  If it is at all possible to share, what criteria is being used for which episodes get included in each day's index?

replies.content: We rate the episodes by highest average participant rating. This will bias the dataset towards the episodes from the top competitors.
